read: [02:54] Amal: Hello. .. [59:55] Amal: Bye. (all 623 turns, lines 1-625)
coverage_note: Whole file read in order. 36:06-42:30 is Latin transliteration in her spelling (‹...›); rows there keep her Latin. 03:31-04:19 is garbled transcription (مهمتي / بابا جان من ميرم بيته سريع / جان ملت) - not scored. [07:32] Amal 'خمسة' after his date line is unreadable as a fix (probably pronunciation of خمسة) - not scored. [08:32] 'فندرة بنية' unknown word (she said ممتاز) - not scored. [06:22] 'قهوة مكينة' let pass, not on sheet - not scored. [32:07] 'مناسبة' for معصبة and [32:27] 'بس بتها' for ببسطها are root/pronunciation slips (S4) - not scored, though she recast ببسطها at 32:38. [33:57] he answered about himself when she asked what SHE does (comprehension miss, no word supplied) and [50:18] 'كان مرة؟' misheard her question - noted, not rows. [34:36] 'hết' is an engine artifact (probably خلص؟). 09:32-16:57 is mostly English about Meet/transcription setup. Listening/comprehension misses are written with mode=listening. Rows 'signal=asked, tier 0' are didn't-knows, kept apart.

rows.medi_said: بس إحنا بدأ...
rows.why: Subject is إحنا but the past verb has no we-ending; she finished it with بدأنا.

rows.medi_said: بدأنا a marketing project who who لازم اشتغلت كتير
rows.why: 'Had to' needs كان stacked on لازم, and after لازم the verb is the bare present أشتغل, not the past اشتغلت; she recast the whole clause.
rows.english: I had to work a lot

rows.medi_said: الله يوفقك.
rows.why: Reply to her يعطيكم العافية; the paired answer is الله يعافيكي (which he gives at 59:42), الله يوفقك is a different blessing; she moved on to مبروك without comment.

rows.medi_said: أنا صحيت على ثمانية.
rows.why: Clock time is el-saa3a + number; he answered 'at eight' with على and no الساعة; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: أنا شربت قهوة مكينة وماء كتير.
rows.why: MSA form ماء instead of her Levantine form; sheet row 'water | Mayy | مي'; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: مش مغني، مغـ، مغـ.
rows.why: مغني is 'singer' (she says so at 08:58); cloudy is مغيم, sheet row 'the weather is cloudy | El-jaw m8ayyem | الجو مغيم'.

rows.medi_said: درجة حرارة.
rows.why: Idafa: first word bare, the owner takes el- (he had first tried الدرجة at 09:09, then dropped el- from the owner); she recast درجة الحرارة.

rows.medi_said: درجة الحرارة حوالين، تمنتاش.
rows.why: He said eighteen for eighty; she echo-questioned, he fixed to تمانين (09:26) and she confirmed ثمانين (09:28); sheet rows 'eighteen | tamanta3sh | تمنتاش' and 'eighty | tamanin | تمانين'.

rows.medi_said: درجة الحرارة حوالين، تمنتاش.
rows.why: Sheet splits 'around / approximately | 7awaali | حوالي' from 'around / surrounding | 7awaalain | حوالين'; he used the surrounding form for approximately; she let it pass (colloquially both are heard).

rows.medi_said: It means it's okay, right? It's positive.
rows.amal_said: ما زبت. It-- معنى it didn't work out.
rows.right: ما زبط = it didn't work out
rows.why: She asked شو يعني ما زبت; he read it as positive/'it's okay', she supplied the meaning; sheet row 'to work out / to work as planned | Zabe6 | زبط'.

rows.medi_said: الـ Google Meet، بقدر، understand. بقدر، آ-آآآ، تفهم-
rows.why: Subject is Google Meet (هو) so the verb takes ي-, not ت-; she recast يفهم.

rows.medi_said: يفهم عربي، بس ما، آآآم، م-م-ما، ما يقدر أكتب عربي.
rows.why: Same subject (Google Meet): أكتب is the I-form, should be يكتب, and the plain present ما يقدر lacks b-; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: هو راح، يأتي، راح ي-يأ-- ي-يأتينا-
rows.why: يأتي is MSA 'come'; for 'it will give/bring us the translation' her sheet has 'i bring | Ana bajeeb | أنا بجيب' / 'i give | Ana ba3ti'; she echoed يأتينا at 14:41 so this is at most a let-pass.
rows.english: it will bring us the translation

rows.medi_said: الـ تاني مشكلة. No.
rows.amal_said: تاني، تاني مشكلة or المشكلة التانية
rows.why: Adjective goes after the noun with el- on both; he put التاني in front; she gave both correct orders.

rows.medi_said: إنه احنا، نكتب في، Arabic or English letters.
rows.why: B3 keeps the b- after إنه; he dropped it; she let it pass.
rows.english: that we write in English letters

rows.medi_said: That's been، I don't remember. أنا ما بـ-- ما، ما بتذكر، هذي الكلمة.
rows.amal_said: فترة means while, a while or period of time.
rows.right: فترة = a while / period of time
rows.why: She asked if he remembers فترة, he said he doesn't, she supplied the meaning (didn't-know, not on her sheet).

rows.medi_said: So what, what makes you sad at this time?
rows.why: He read her بتعبك as 'makes you sad'; she repeated the word, then at 18:41 corrected 'Tired'; sheet row 'i tire / make people tired | Ana bata33eb | بتعِّب'.
rows.english: what tires you most these days

rows.medi_said: okay, tell me... Tell me كم مرة الجملة؟
rows.why: He wanted 'the sentence again' = كمان مرة (her own phrase at 22:10 بدك تقرأها كمان مرة); كم مرة means 'how many times'; sheet row 'also / more / too | Kamaan | كمان'; she just repeated the sentence.

rows.medi_said: لما، أشتغل مع إي- عيلتنا كتير. و... هو، هما ما، ما، ما يخلصوا.
rows.why: Plain present negative keeps the b- (he himself says ما بيخلصوا at 22:48); she only echoed يخلصوا at 20:14.

rows.medi_said: وأنا لازم كل اليوم، أطلبهم أو أطلب-- is it أطلب لهم or أطلبهم؟
rows.why: طلب takes من for the person asked; he tried a direct object ending and لهم, then asked; sheet row 'i order/request/ask for | Ana ba6lub (min) | أنا بطلب'.
rows.english: I have to ask them all day

rows.medi_said: كام... كاملة؟
rows.why: She asked for الجملة كاملة and he did not know the word; she repeated it until he got 'complete' (22:01); sheet row 'whole / complete | kaamel | كامل'.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتعب كتير لما عيلتنا-- عيلتي، اللي، أشتغل معهم. و هو...
rows.why: The family members are plural (اللي أشتغل معهم), so the pronoun/subject is هما not هو; she recast.

rows.medi_said: هما ما بيخلصوا اشتغلتهم.
rows.why: He used the verb اشتغلت as the noun 'their work'; the noun is شغل + هم; sheet row 'work | Shu8ul | شغل'.

rows.medi_said: شغلهم. و، لازم، لازم أطلب، أطلبهم-
rows.why: Repeat of 20:20 - طلب takes من; she supplied منهم again.

rows.medi_said: أطلب منهم كتير إنو، يخلص، يخلصهم؟
rows.why: 'They finish it (the work)' needs the they-form يخلصوا plus the object ending -ه for شغلهم; he put a they-ending as object on a he-form; she recast يخلصوه.

rows.medi_said: ... بتضل تعصب، تعصب، زمان طويل.
rows.why: 'For a long time' is لوقت طويل (sheet row 'for a long time | la-wa2et taweel | لوقت طويل'); زمان is 'long ago' (sheet 'a long time ago | Min zamaan | من زمان'); she recast, also adding the لَ.

rows.medi_said: ... بتضل تعصب، تعصب، زمان طويل.
rows.amal_said: خطيبتي ما بتضل تعصب. Here، لما تحكيها بالانجليزي you say, "My fiancée doesn't stay angry." So it's angry, not to get angry. It's the adjective.
rows.why: After بتضل (stays) the state word is the participle/adjective معصبة, not the verb تعصب; she named the rule (adjective, not verb) and prompted him to fix it.

rows.medi_said: و أنا, that's... We never did this word. it's أنا بـ بنزبط. Is it b- بنزبطها؟
rows.why: He took her meta-remark لازم نزبط (we must fix) as the verb for 'I make her happy'; the verb is ببسطها; sheet row 'it causes happiness / makes someone happy | Byebse6 | بيبسط'.

rows.medi_said: إذا أناaa, بحكيلها.
rows.why: No b- after إذا per B3; she echoed بحكيلها at 27:23 and moved on.

rows.medi_said: بحكيلها. أناaa, أنا أعمل، ب- أ- أ- أعمل؟ بـ... أعمل. أعمل غلط. أنا-
rows.amal_said: أنا, I did something wrong. What's I made-
rows.why: The clause is past ('I did something wrong'); he was stuck on the bare present أعمل; she prompted 'I did', he asked عملت or خليت, she confirmed عملت (27:54) and he produced أنا عملت إشي غلط (27:59).

rows.medi_said: So ما, ما بتضل معصب؟
rows.why: Subject خطيبتي is feminine so the adjective takes -ة; she recast معصبة.

rows.medi_said: بأسف
rows.why: He made 'I apologize' by putting b- on the adjective أسف; the verb form is بتأسف, which she confirmed at 30:06 after he found it; sheet row 'sorry | aasef | آسف'.

rows.medi_said: لما، أتأس-- أت-- أتأسف.
rows.amal_said: And أتأسف takes لا so to her, أتأسف لها.
rows.why: Didn't-know: she supplied the fixed preposition لَ (verb + its preposition) before he attempted the object; not an error he made.

rows.medi_said: okay. so لما أنا، لما أنا بأعمل غلط، إشي غلط.
rows.why: b- must drop after لما; he kept it; she answered Mm-hmm (she does recast the same rule at 48:55 and 55:35).

rows.medi_said: إن، إنتي ما-
rows.why: He addressed 'you' (إنتي) when the sentence is about his fiancée (هي); she recast and he said sorry.

rows.medi_said: وقت كتير.
rows.why: 'A long time' takes طويل not كتير; sheet row 'for a long time | la-wa2et taweel | لوقت طويل'; she said لا and gave the phrase (second time this lesson, see 26:00).

rows.medi_said: عتيته أنا، بنت-- بنتطلع، بنتطلع بنات أخوي-
rows.amal_said: بنطلع؟ ... Yeah, we say we take care of. ... ‹Bindir›. ... ‹balna›.
rows.right: بندير بالنا على (her Latin: ‹bindir balna› ... ‹ala binat akhui›)
rows.why: He calqued English 'watch (the kids)' with بنتطلع (we look); she questioned it, said 'we say we take care of' and built بندير بالنا with him; sheet row 'i take care of | Ana badir baali | أنا بدير بالي'.

rows.medi_said: Wouldn't it be ‹balhom› 'cause we're watching the kids?
rows.amal_said: No, we are... Still this is part of the verb. So we- ... ‹bindir balna›, but then ‹fi› preposition after ‹shuhuwah›.
rows.why: The ending on بال is part of the verb and matches the subject (we -> بالنا), the object comes after the preposition على; she said no and explained.

rows.medi_said: So is it ‹yahom›?
rows.why: He reached for إياهم as the second object; دير بال takes على; she gave على.

rows.medi_said: ‹Alayhom›.
rows.why: A noun (بنات أخوي) follows, so the preposition stays bare على with no pronoun ending; she corrected and he produced ‹Ala binat akhui› (38:15).

rows.medi_said: ooh, I wanna say both of us. Do I just say ‹tinen›? Or-
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked how to say 'both of us' and she supplied إحنا التنين (not on her sheet).

rows.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
rows.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
rows.why: بخاف من takes من before a noun but not before a verb clause (نكون أهل); she said 'here you don't need min' and recast بنخاف نكون.

rows.medi_said: ‹Ana lazim, astamel il fa'il›, instead, instead is... Oh my God.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he reached for 'instead', she said they hadn't learned it and supplied بدل (not on her sheet).

rows.medi_said: What was verb again? Sorry. It was-
rows.why: He forgot the word for verb and asked; she supplied فعل; sheet row 'verb – verbs | Fe3el | فعل'.

rows.medi_said: Is, ‹isma›.
rows.why: He produced اسمه/isma for 'noun'; the bare noun is اسم; sheet row 'noun – nouns | Esem | اسم'; she recast (could be a vowel slip only).

rows.medi_said: بخوفنا.
rows.why: Subject is 'it' (being parents) so the verb needs the he-prefix بي- as she had just said (42:41 بس بتحكي بي); بخوفنا reads as 'I scare us', and his next try يخوفنا (42:53) lacks the b-; she said ممتاز; the ي may be a transcription drop.

rows.medi_said: What, what?
rows.amal_said: I said it slow so you can catch it. بتخططوا.
rows.why: He did not catch بتخططوا in her sentence and she repeated it slowly; sheet row 'i plan | Ana ba5a66et | أنا بخطط'.

rows.medi_said: إحنا، إحنا بنخ-- بنخط. Ben-- it's just بنخط، right?
rows.why: He asked whether the we-form is بنخط (missing the second ط of خطط); she gave بنخطط; sheet row 'i plan | Ana ba5a66et | أنا بخطط' (could be filed as F3 sound shape instead).

rows.medi_said: بنخطط. اه، يكونوا أهل.
rows.why: Subject is إحنا so ykoon takes the we-form نكون, not the they-form يكونوا; she recast and held him to it (43:51 بس).

rows.medi_said: بتعصب. So in, in general, do you say الكل if I wanna say in general?
rows.why: He proposed الكل and then على كلٍ (Farsi 'as a whole') for 'in general'; she said no, then 'بلاش. Sounds wrong' (46:19) and supplied بشكل عام (46:42); not on her sheet.

rows.medi_said: اه. So it has to be, has to be، اه، issue can، اه، can issue-
rows.why: 'It has to be (a bad issue)' is لازم + يكون; he was building it with 'can' (يقدر); she said no can, it's 'it', and gave لازم يكون issue سيء (48:23) which he repeated.
rows.english: it has to be a really bad issue

rows.medi_said: لازم يكون issue سيء. سيء كتير.
rows.why: English 'issue' inside an Arabic sentence; the nearest sheet row is 'no problem | mesh mushkelah | مش مشكلة' and he used مشكلة himself at 15:31; low because Amal used 'issue' in her own recast at 48:23.

rows.medi_said: عشان، اه، بعصب
rows.why: b- drops after عشان; she recast أعصب and confirmed his 'عشان gets rid of be?' (49:01).

rows.medi_said: ولا إشي، ولا إشي بيعص-- بعصبني
rows.why: Subject is ولا إشي (it), so the verb needs the he-prefix بي-; بعصبني is the I-form; she recast بيعصبني.

rows.medi_said: آآآه، هي، آآآه. She doesn't get-- هي ما، ما تعصب
rows.why: Plain present negative keeps the b- after ما; she recast بتعصب and he repeated هي ما بتعصب.

rows.medi_said: ما-- هي ما بتعصب، آآآه، سهل كمان
rows.why: He used the adjective سهل (easy) as 'easily'; she replaced it with the adverb 'quickly' = بسرعة (sheet 'quickly / hurry up | Bsur3a | بسرعة'; 'easy | Sahel | سهل'), and confirmed بسرعة at 51:20.
rows.english: she doesn't get angry quickly either

rows.medi_said: مظلوم يعني، آآآه، مش صوت، آآآه، طويل، وما، ما بنعصب، وما، آآآه-
rows.amal_said: Well, that's not the same meaning. هذا مش نفس المعنى بالعربي
rows.why: Farsi mazloom (calm, unreactive) is Arabic مظلوم = oppressed; she said it is not the same meaning and supplied رايق (52:57); not on her sheet.

rows.medi_said: مظلوم يعني، آآآه، مش صوت، آآآه، طويل، وما، ما بنعصب
rows.why: 'Loud voice' is صوت عالي; طويل is long/tall; sheet row 'loud/high volume | Soat 3aali | صوت عالي'; she answered only the مظلوم meaning.

rows.medi_said: لما أنا لما أزآن.
rows.why: He misheard her زهقان and produced the non-word أزآن / أزأل; she said no twice and re-said زهقان; sheet row 'bored | Zahqaan | زهقان'.

rows.medi_said: زهآن. زهآن. بس، آه، لما بزهأ.
rows.why: b- drops after لما; she recast لما أزهق.

rows.medi_said: أنا بكرى أو، أو. Oh, I can say ولا right؟ ولا،
rows.amal_said: أو؟ ... ولا is used more for options يعني.
rows.why: In a plain statement 'I read or choose a series' the 'or' is أو; ولا is for either-or choices; she questioned it, explained, and he settled on أو (56:13).

rows.medi_said: أغو، أغير الجو.
rows.why: Ordinary present needs b-; he gave the bare أغير twice (58:06, 58:18); she recast بغير جو.

rows.medi_said: بغير الجو.
rows.why: The set phrase has no el- (sheet row 'i change scenery | Ba8ayyer jaw | بغير جو'); she said 'No ال' and he still repeated بغير الجو at 58:26.
rows.english: I get a change of scenery

rows.medi_said: عملنا كتير.
rows.why: She asked 'what did we do?' twice until he supplied an object (عملنا تمرين كتير, 59:15); reading this as her wanting a complete verb+object sentence, low confidence.
